source_reference.title: NIST IR 8536 — Supply Chain Traceability: Manufacturing Meta-Framework
source_reference.reference_implementation_status_at_publi: The 2026-09-09 NIST announcement said the Python implementation was in final review. The final IR Appendix F.4 points to https://github.com/usnistgov/ir8536-reference-implementation. Appendix F describes an early-stage lab/research MVP, not production software. Exact repository revision, licence, tests and source were not inspected in this pass.
source_reference.implementation_claim_boundary: No NIST reference-implementation parity or execution claim is made. Pin and inspect the repository before differential testing.

mappings.concept: Product, lot, component, facility and parent/child subject identity
current_surface: Mycelix SDK productId and optional batchId
gaps: distinguish SKU/family from article/serial, batch/lot, material heat, shipment unit and assembly
preserve identifier scheme and issuer
active Holochain supplychain workspace remains unverified
tests: same-looking identifiers in different schemes must not join
wrong lot/serial/parent reference is rejected or indeterminate
partial identity must not be silently completed

mappings.concept: Typed traceability event and transformation semantics
current_surface: Symtropy #3025 MTConnect and QIF mapping owner
gaps: do not conflate checkpoint action vocabulary with EPCIS or archived Rust EventType
pin source schema/profile/version
preserve unknown event types
tests: source-native event type preserved on import/export
missing transformation input does not get inferred

mappings.concept: Temporal event ordering and traceability sequence
current_surface: archived Rust VC issuanceDate and credentialSubject.timestamp
gaps: occurrence, source-system, ingestion, issuance, effective and verification time need separate semantics
clock offset/uncertainty and partial order are not represented by the in-memory SDK checkpoint type
tests: clock offset and overlapping event intervals
ingestion time must not overwrite source occurrence time

mappings.concept: Actor, issuer and verifiable source of an event
current_surface: Mycelix #5149 signer authority and approval receipts
gaps: local SDK handlerDid string construction is not DID resolution
caller identity and evidence verified boolean are not signature checks
archived standalone verify_vc_jwt remains a TODO
tests: caller assertion cannot self-upgrade to authenticated

mappings.concept: Link traceability events, transformation inputs/outputs and lineage
current_surface: archived Rust DkgClaim lineage hash and previous claims
gaps: local in-memory chain and Holochain client path are separate
archived lineage hash is not proof of physical truth or issuer authority
offline reconstruction not established

mappings.concept: Supporting artefacts, measurements, certificates and observation provenance
gaps: caller-supplied verified boolean is an assertion
no mandatory source digest/locator/method/calibration in the in-memory CheckpointEvidence type
do not conflate telemetry with inspection or approval
tests: verified true without independent receipt stays asserted

mappings.concept: Interoperability with existing sector-specific traceability standards
gaps: exact schema/profile releases must be pinned separately
do not normalize source standards into a lossy universal row
NIST reference implementation not yet independently exercised in this programme
tests: differential comparison against official reference when released

mappings.concept: Share only fields permitted for a stakeholder and purpose
current_surface: archived standalone supplychain README claims SD-JWT/BBS+
gaps: archived Rust crypto module explicitly describes SD-JWT/BBS+ as future support
no selective-disclosure generator/verifier in inspected archived source
need leakage and linkability assessment
tests: proof verifies against issuer and exact profile

mappings.concept: Preserve historical record while exposing corrections, revocation, supersession and disputes
gaps: exact maintained field/state contract and Holochain qualification must be pinned

mappings.concept: Keep event/provenance distinct from conformity, ownership, legal status and execution authority
gaps: UI/API result labels must reflect distinct assurance dimensions
no signed event or DPP URI may mint approval, title or regulatory status
tests: DPP/QR external ID cannot become article identity without verified binding
traceability receipt cannot authorize payment, dispatch or release

claim_limits: This crosswalk is not NIST conformance or certification.
A digest proves integrity relative to referenced bytes, not factual truth.
A signature proves an assertion was signed by a key under a policy, not that the physical event occurred.
A provenance graph does not establish ownership, lawful origin, sustainability, conformity, compliance, delivery or release.
Do not treat the in-memory SDK and the Holochain client wrapper as one qualified implementation.
